title: USNI News Fleet and Marine Tracker: Oct. 13, 2026
total: These are the approximate positions of the U.S. Navy’s deployed carrier strike groups and amphibious ready groups throughout the world as of Oct. 13, 2026, based on Navy and public data. In cases in which a CSG or ARG is conducting disaggregated operations, the chart reflects the location of the capital ship.

properties.name: In the Pacific Ocean
properties.said:
Aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) is transiting the Pacific Ocean in U.S. 7th Fleet westward on deployment.

Carrier Strike Group 9 is composed of Theodore Roosevelt , Carrier Air Wing (CVW) 11, Destroyer Squadron 23, Information Warfare Squadron 9 and Ticonderoga-class guided-missile cruiser USS Chosin (CG-65).

properties.name: In the Caribbean
properties.said:
USS Minneapolis-Saint Paul (LCS 21) Freedom-variant littoral combat ship and USNS Pathfinder (T-AGS-60) Pathfinder-class oceanographic survey ship in Ponce, Puerto Rico – October 7, 2026 SRC: X-@MichaelBonet8 https://t.co/QXqapKnp8p

— WarshipCam (@WarshipCam) October 8, 2026

Littoral combat ship USS Minneapolis–Saint Paul (LCS-21) is operating in the Central Caribbean Sea . The Freedom-class LCS is based at Naval Station Mayport, Fla.

USS St. Louis (LCS-19) arrived Friday in Port Everglades, Fla., according to ship spotters .

properties.name: In the Western Atlantic
properties.said:
Littoral combat ship USS Billings (LCS-15) completed its 6-month deployment and returned Saturday to its homeport of Mayport, Fla., according to ship spotters .

USS San Antonio (LPD-17) is operating off the East Coast. The amphibious ship previously operated in the Caribbean with elements of the 24th Marine Expeditionary Unit as Littoral Combat Force 24.

Aircraft carrier USS Nimitz (CVN-68) departed Oct. 5 and returned Thursday to Norfolk, according to ship spotters .

In addition to these major formations, not shown are others serving in submarines, individual surface ships, aircraft squadrons, SEALs, Special Purpose Marine Air-Ground Task Forces, Seabees, EOD Mobile Units and more throughout the globe.
